Class 2 · Chapter 3 of 9

Find number and picture rules

Spot the rule in number rows and growing pictures, then use it again.

  1. See it
  2. Try it
  3. Practise it
  4. Print it
  5. Check it

This chapter works best after Add, subtract and make equal groups. You can still look around, or jump to the check.

By the end I can…

  • I can continue a number series.
  • I can continue a growing picture.
  • I can use the same rule for a new number.

1 See it

Screen 1 of 4

A number series has a rule

Look at 5, 10, 15, 20. Each number is 5 more than the one before.

The rule is add 5. The next number is 25.

Screen 2 of 4

Pictures can repeat

Triangle, square, square, triangle, square, square.

The repeat unit is triangle, square, square. It comes round again and again.

Screen 3 of 4

Growing pictures

Picture 1 has 1 tile. Picture 2 has 3 tiles. Picture 3 has 5 tiles.

Each picture adds 2 more tiles. Picture 4 will have 7.

Screen 4 of 4

A rule machine

A machine follows one rule every time. This machine adds 3.

2 goes in and 5 comes out. 10 goes in and 13 comes out.

Words to know
rule
What happens each time, like add 5 or add 2 more tiles.
series
Numbers in a row that follow a rule.
repeat unit
The small piece that comes round again and again.

For parents

What your child learns

Patterns appear in rows, grids and rules. A rule machine does the same thing to every number that goes in. In a grid, find what changes across a row and down a column.

A common slip

Children often check only one row or one column. Test the rule on every given example. Count positions from the correct end.

5-minute home activity: Rule machine

  1. Pick a rule, such as double it and add 2.
  2. Say a number and let your child say the output.
  3. Write 4 pairs of in and out numbers.
  4. Swap roles and guess the rule from the pairs.
